record_type: GitHub Actions troubleshooting and live publication handoff

events.title: Research automation required attention
events.description: 7AM task returned requires_user_action with no explanation and was paused, preventing normal automatic handoff.

events.title: Research recovered
events.description: Re-enabled research automation and committed nine original daily concept briefs; re-reviewed three Pinterest references and archived copies in that day's private folder.

events.title: Expected publishing output absent
events.description: By noon there were no October 27 image assets or RSS records from the scheduled GitHub publisher; a new recovery run was initiated.

events.title: OpenAI first image request failed
events.description: GitHub recovery run reported HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on the first image-generation request.

events.title: Credit balance exhausted diagnosed
events.description: Exact response was HTTP 429 insufficient_quota / credit_balance_exhausted. GitHub key was present but there were no API credits.

events.title: API credits added; retry initiated
events.description: User funded API with $10 and the failed image job was retried at GPT Image 2 Medium quality.

events.title: Nine original AI images generated
events.description: Recovery run completed with nine distinct new photographs, updated source-image hashes and a successful site deployment.

events.title: Metricool scheduling started
events.description: First original image accepted at 1:30 PM, remaining eight queued at half-hour and evening intervals with autoPublish enabled.

events.title: All nine Metricool receipts verified
events.description: Nine provider IDs confirmed, all with stored images and correct target article URLs. PENDING is a scheduling status, not published proof.

events.title: Double-posting protection added
events.description: Switched future image generation to Metricool-first. Removed today's nine RSS duplicates after direct scheduling, though past import cannot be reversed.

events.title: Hourly scheduling guard created
events.description: Automated guard checks outstanding images and provider receipts hourly; it does not create duplicate items or override posting quotas.

events.title: First October 27 Pinterest pin confirmed published
events.description: Connected Metricool readback confirmed post 408053788 as PUBLISHED with provider pin ID 947163365478236183. Remaining eight Oct 27 pins are PENDING, with nine original images and correct article links verified. No duplicate scheduling attempted.
